title: SDG 04-6-1: Proficiency in Functional Literacy and Numeracy
description: Proportion of population in a given age group achieving at least a fixed level of proficiency in functional literacy and numeracy skills by state and sex, as per the specifications of SDG Indicator 4-6-1.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency.

fields.name: sex
fields.title: Sex
fields.description: [Categorical] Either both sexes ('both'), male ('male') or female ('female')

fields.name: proportion
fields.title: Proportion (%)
fields.description: [Categorical] Proportion of the population achieving at least a fixed level of proficiency in functional literacy and numeracy skills.

methodology: This dataset is tabulated from survey data collected via the Labour Force Survey (LFS) conducted on a monthly basis by the Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM). It is collected as part of Malaysia's monitoring of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), in line with the most recent [SDG Global Indicator Framework](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sdg.pdf).
